output.revised_prompt: Create isolated production title artwork for a premium mobile slot game. Render the exact text, verbatim and only once: “DIAMOND JACKPOT”. The entire title must appear in one centered horizontal line. Use bold, thick, powerful, highly legible faceted uppercase casino lettering designed to read clearly at mobile size. Letter faces are brilliant diamond-white with subtle crystal faceting; bevels are polished champagne gold; deep burgundy inner shadows add depth; include only restrained emerald glass accents integrated into the letter detailing and a few controlled crystal glints. Premium jackpot-marquee highlights, celebratory and exciting, luxurious rather than gaudy. Wide centered composition with generous empty margin on all sides. The title is the only subject: no plaque, no frame, no banner, no icon, no detached diamonds, no extra text, no logo, no watermark. Background must be perfectly flat, completely uniform solid chroma-key magenta #FF00FF edge to edge, with no texture, gradient, vignette, particles, shadow, reflection, cast shadow, or glow touching the background. Absolutely no magenta anywhere in the lettering. Avoid sci-fi, neon cyberpunk, script fonts, thin letters, black background, and illegibility. Clean, crisp production asset with sharply defined edges.
